steps.meta: Find your Facebook Page ID (your Page → About → Page transparency) and paste it here. Leads from your ad forms then come in by themselves.
steps.website_form: Paste this code into your website where the form should appear. It has a consent box, which the law needs. Switch this source on first.
steps.google_sheets: Open your Google Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script. Paste this, save, then add a trigger that runs "sendNewRowsToMitra" every minute.
steps.google_forms: Open your Google Form → ⋮ → Apps Script. Paste this, save, then add an "On form submit" trigger. Name one question "Phone".
steps.google_ads: In Google Ads, open your lead form → Lead delivery → Webhook. Paste this address, and paste your secret key as the "Key".
steps.indiamart: Ask IndiaMART to push leads to this address, or paste your IndiaMART CRM key below and Mitra fetches new enquiries every few minutes.
steps.justdial: Send this address to your JustDial account manager and ask them to push leads to it.
steps.zapier: Add a "Webhooks → POST" step in Zapier, Make, Pabbly or n8n with this address, the header below, and your lead's name and phone.
steps.api: Send each lead as JSON with your secret key in the X-Mitra-Secret header. We reply 202 at once and call within a minute.
